notes:
• New buy / trade flow: customers fill in a form on the iPad or a kiosk (name, phone, email, sell or trade, what they brought) and get a ticket number. Open the form from Offer creator → 🧾 Customers at the counter → Open customer form
• The back PC sees them under 🧾 Customers at the counter (how long each has waited) — ▶ Start makes the offer with their name and games and goes to Scan
• Each ticket moves along by itself — Waiting → Scanning → Pricing → Offer ready → Accepted → Done — on the Board (website /staff/buy/board)
• On the iPad the customer taps Cash / Store credit / E-gift card, reads the authorization, types their name and signs with a finger (parent/guardian too if under 18), or taps No thanks. The card list shows like the printout
• The signature comes back into the offer within seconds: it's marked accepted and the printout shows the ticked choice, signature, name and date
